sentences.text: Sam quiere escribir la vida de David y Laura para el grupo del equipo.
sentences.english: Sam wants to write the life story of David and Laura for the team group.

sentences.text: Los dos viven en el pueblo desde hace ocho años.
sentences.english: The two have lived in the village for eight years.

sentences.text: Hoy son líderes de un ministerio con jóvenes.
sentences.english: Today they are leaders of a ministry with young people.

sentences.text: Hoy el ministerio tiene un taller y una granja.
sentences.english: Today the ministry has a workshop and a farm.

sentences.text: Una tarde, Sam llega a su casa con su celular y muchas preguntas.
sentences.english: One afternoon, Sam arrives at their house with his phone and many questions.

sentences.text: —Pasá, Sam —dice Laura—.
sentences.english: "Come in, Sam," says Laura.

sentences.text: Primero el café.
sentences.english: "Coffee first."

sentences.text: Hace diez años, David era ingeniero y Laura era directora de una escuela.
sentences.english: Ten years ago, David was an engineer and Laura was the director of a school.

sentences.text: No eran ricos, pero tenían una casa, un carro y buenos amigos.
sentences.english: They were not rich, but they had a house, a car and good friends.

sentences.text: Un día, una brigada médica de su iglesia viajó a Honduras, y ellos fueron con el grupo.
sentences.english: One day, a medical brigade from their church traveled to Honduras, and they went with the group.

sentences.text: Durante dos semanas trabajaron en un pueblo pequeño.
sentences.english: For two weeks they worked in a small village.

sentences.text: Allí vieron a mucha gente pobre.
sentences.english: There they saw many poor people.

sentences.text: David trabajó con los campesinos y arregló un camino.
sentences.english: David worked with the farmers and fixed a road.

sentences.text: Laura ayudó en la clínica.
sentences.english: Laura helped in the clinic.

sentences.text: —Volvimos a casa, pero no podíamos olvidar el pueblo —dice Laura.
sentences.english: "We went back home, but we could not forget the village," says Laura.

sentences.text: —Esa fue la razón —dice David—.
sentences.english: "That was the reason," says David.

sentences.text: Tenían razón los vecinos: el pueblo nos necesitaba.
sentences.english: "The neighbors were right: the village needed us.

sentences.text: No hay una sola solución, pero siempre hay una.
sentences.english: There is no single solution, but there is always one."

sentences.text: Teníamos buenos empleos, pero queríamos servir.
sentences.english: "We had good jobs, but we wanted to serve."

sentences.text: Hablaron con su familia y con su pastor, y oraron muchos meses.
sentences.english: They talked with their family and their pastor, and they prayed for many months.

sentences.text: Por esta razón, por fin decidieron dejar su país.
sentences.english: For this reason, at last they decided to leave their country.

sentences.text: David dejó su empleo, y Laura dejó su escuela.
sentences.english: David left his job, and Laura left her school.

sentences.text: Llegaron a Honduras en enero.
sentences.english: They arrived in Honduras in January.

sentences.text: Entraron a la casa de una familia del pueblo.
sentences.english: They went into the house of a family in the village.

sentences.text: No hablaban bien el idioma.
sentences.english: They did not speak the language well.

sentences.text: El primer problema fue el idioma.
sentences.english: The first problem was the language.

sentences.text: —Yo quería decir «gracias» y decía otra palabra —cuenta Laura—.
sentences.english: "I wanted to say 'thank you' and I said another word," Laura tells.

sentences.text: La gente me miraba y no comprendía.
sentences.english: "People looked at me and did not understand."

sentences.text: La solución fue estudiar todos los días y hablar con los vecinos.
sentences.english: The solution was to study every day and talk with the neighbors.

sentences.text: Lucharon mucho.
sentences.english: They struggled a lot.

sentences.text: Cada noche estudiaban hasta tarde, y el esfuerzo fue grande.
sentences.english: Every night they studied until late, and the effort was great.

sentences.text: —Luchamos con el idioma y luchamos con el calor —dice Laura—.
sentences.english: "We fought with the language and we fought with the heat," says Laura.

sentences.text: Con esfuerzo, todo se puede.
sentences.english: "With effort, everything is possible."

sentences.text: Un año después lograron hablar sin problemas.
sentences.english: A year later they managed to speak without problems.

sentences.text: Hubo problemas con el agua, y la solución fue ayudar entre todos.
sentences.english: There were problems with the water, and the solution was to help one another.

sentences.text: Hubo otras cosas difíciles: la comida, el calor y los insectos.
sentences.english: There were other hard things: the food, the heat and the insects.

sentences.text: En marzo, Laura se enfermó de dengue.
sentences.english: In March, Laura got sick with dengue.

sentences.text: Tuvo fiebre durante una semana.
sentences.english: She had a fever for a week.

sentences.text: La farmacia estaba lejos, pero doña Marta la cuidó.
sentences.english: The pharmacy was far away, but doña Marta took care of her.

sentences.text: Laura sanó, pero el susto fue grande.
sentences.english: Laura healed, but the fright was big.

sentences.text: David se rompió un dedo con un martillo.
sentences.english: David broke a finger with a hammer.

sentences.text: Una abeja entró a la casa, y los dos gritaron.
sentences.english: A bee came into the house, and the two of them shouted.

sentences.text: —Aprendimos poco a poco —dice David.
sentences.english: "We learned little by little," says David.

sentences.text: La diferencia más grande fue la cultura.
sentences.english: The biggest difference was the culture.

sentences.text: En su país, la gente llegaba a la hora.
sentences.english: In their country, people arrived on time.

sentences.text: En el pueblo, la hora era diferente.
sentences.english: In the village, time was different.

sentences.text: Una tradición del pueblo es el abrazo y el beso al llegar y al despedirse.
sentences.english: A tradition of the village is the hug and the kiss when arriving and when saying goodbye.

sentences.text: David y Laura no tenían esa tradición, pero la aprendieron.
sentences.english: David and Laura did not have that tradition, but they learned it.

sentences.text: —Una cultura no es mejor que otra: es diferente —dice Laura.
sentences.english: "One culture is not better than another: it is different," says Laura.

sentences.text: Hay diferencias entre las culturas, pero la gente es gente.
sentences.english: There are differences between cultures, but people are people.

sentences.text: Aprender una cultura toma tiempo.
sentences.english: Learning a culture takes time.

sentences.text: La sociedad del pueblo era pequeña, pero todos se conocían.
sentences.english: The society of the village was small, but everyone knew each other.

sentences.text: Los vecinos les dieron la bienvenida.
sentences.english: The neighbors welcomed them.

sentences.text: La sociedad del pueblo los recibió como a una familia.
sentences.english: The society of the village received them like a family.

sentences.text: En esa sociedad, un patrón y un empleado se saludaban como amigos.
sentences.english: In that society, a boss and an employee greeted each other like friends.

sentences.text: La tradición del domingo es comer con toda la familia, y ellos también la aprendieron.
sentences.english: The Sunday tradition is eating with the whole family, and they learned that too.

sentences.text: Después del primer año, David y Laura se dedicaron al ministerio con los jóvenes.
sentences.english: After the first year, David and Laura dedicated themselves to the ministry with the young people.

sentences.text: Dedicaron sus mañanas a la escuela y sus tardes a los jóvenes.
sentences.english: They dedicated their mornings to the school and their afternoons to the young people.

sentences.text: Durante tres años, con ayuda de los campesinos, lograron abrir un taller.
sentences.english: For three years, with the help of the farmers, they managed to open a workshop.

sentences.text: David enseñó a usar las herramientas: un martillo, clavos, una cuerda, un cubo y una escoba.
sentences.english: David taught how to use the tools: a hammer, nails, a rope, a bucket and a broom.

sentences.text: Los jóvenes aprendieron a cavar, sembrar y plantar.
sentences.english: The young people learned to dig, sow and plant.

sentences.text: Con una granja pequeña, cultivaron frijoles y tomates.
sentences.english: With a small farm, they grew beans and tomatoes.

sentences.text: Regaban las semillas con cubos de agua.
sentences.english: They watered the seeds with buckets of water.

sentences.text: Un panadero les enseñó a hacer pan, y un pescador les contó cómo trabaja el mar.
sentences.english: A baker taught them to make bread, and a fisherman told them how the sea works.

sentences.text: Un comerciante les enseñó a vender, y el director del colegio los visitó.
sentences.english: A merchant taught them to sell, and the director of the high school visited them.

sentences.text: El resultado fue muy bueno, y fue el resultado del esfuerzo de todos.
sentences.english: The result was very good, and it was the result of everyone's effort.

sentences.text: Durante el día, los jóvenes trabajan en el taller.
sentences.english: During the day, the young people work in the workshop.

sentences.text: Muchos jóvenes tienen trabajo: un joven es hoy empleado, y otro es patrón.
sentences.english: Many young people have work: one young man is today an employee, and another is a boss.

sentences.text: Otro resultado es el agua limpia.
sentences.english: Another result is the clean water.

sentences.text: Un ejemplo es Diego, que hoy es empleado de Carlos.
sentences.english: One example is Diego, who is today Carlos's employee.

sentences.text: Otro ejemplo es Rafael, el panadero.
sentences.english: Another example is Rafael, the baker.

sentences.text: El éxito no llegó pronto.
sentences.english: Success did not come soon.

sentences.text: Llegó poco a poco.
sentences.english: It came little by little.

sentences.text: —No buscábamos el éxito —dice David—.
sentences.english: "We were not looking for success," says David.

sentences.text: Buscábamos servir.
sentences.english: "We were looking to serve.

sentences.text: Pero el éxito llegó.
sentences.english: But success came."

sentences.text: —La causa era una: amar a la gente.
sentences.english: "The cause was one: to love people.

sentences.text: Logramos más de lo que pensamos.
sentences.english: We achieved more than we thought.

sentences.text: Muchas personas trabajan por esta causa.
sentences.english: Many people work for this cause.

sentences.text: Es una buena causa.
sentences.english: It is a good cause."

sentences.text: Laura se dedica a las mujeres de la iglesia, y es su líder, y David es líder de los jóvenes.
sentences.english: Laura dedicates herself to the women of the church, and is their leader, and David is the leader of the young people.

sentences.text: Un buen líder escucha primero.
sentences.english: A good leader listens first.

sentences.text: Una vez, en el culto, el pastor contó el cuento del hijo que se fue.
sentences.english: Once, at the service, the pastor told the story of the son who left.

sentences.text: Laura lloró.
sentences.english: Laura cried.

sentences.text: Laura habló del pecado y de la compasión.
sentences.english: Laura spoke about sin and compassion.

sentences.text: Se vio en el joven que pecó, se arrepintió y volvió.
sentences.english: She saw herself in the young man who sinned, repented and returned.

sentences.text: Desde el primer día deseaban servir.
sentences.english: From the first day they wanted to serve.

sentences.text: El papá tuvo compasión, le puso un anillo y lo besó.
sentences.english: The dad had compassion, put a ring on him and kissed him.

sentences.text: —Yo también necesito compasión —dijo Laura—.
sentences.english: "I also need compassion," said Laura.

sentences.text: Todos la necesitamos.
sentences.english: "We all need it."

sentences.text: —No somos ricos, pero tenemos todo —dice David—.
sentences.english: "We are not rich, but we have everything," says David.

sentences.text: Hay cosas que el dinero no compra.
sentences.english: "There are things money does not buy."

sentences.text: —Hay una manera de vivir: servir a la gente.
sentences.english: "There is a way of living: serving people.

sentences.text: La diferencia es grande.
sentences.english: The difference is big."

sentences.text: Laura habla del pasado, del presente y del futuro.
sentences.english: Laura talks about the past, the present and the future.

sentences.text: —El pasado fue difícil, pero aprendimos mucho.
sentences.english: "The past was hard, but we learned a lot.

sentences.text: No olvidamos el pasado.
sentences.english: We do not forget the past."

sentences.text: —En el presente tenemos veinte jóvenes.
sentences.english: "In the present we have twenty young people.

sentences.text: Los niños corren por el patio, y la casa siempre tiene gente.
sentences.english: The children run through the patio, and the house always has people."

sentences.text: —Trabajamos desde la mañana hasta la noche, pero estamos contentos.
sentences.english: "We work from morning until night, but we are happy.

sentences.text: Desde ese día, Laura cuenta el cuento a los jóvenes.
sentences.english: Since that day, Laura tells the story to the young people."

sentences.text: —En el futuro queremos abrir otro taller.
sentences.english: "In the future we want to open another workshop.

sentences.text: Pensamos en el futuro de los jóvenes.
sentences.english: We think about the future of the young people.

sentences.text: El presente es lo que tenemos, y es bueno.
sentences.english: The present is what we have, and it is good."

sentences.text: Sam termina de escribir.
sentences.english: Sam finishes writing.

sentences.text: Piensa: «David y Laura son un ejemplo para todos nosotros».
sentences.english: He thinks: "David and Laura are an example for all of us."
